title: Support for Home-based Persons with Motor Neurone Diseases
what_it_is: Support for Home-based Persons with Motor Neurone Diseases

sections.label: MND transport and home care
sections.summary: Wheelchair-bound MND patients can use private ambulances, and NNI offers video consultations and home nursing care for stable patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Wheelchair-bound MND patients can tap on private ambulances for transportation between their home and the clinic.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Special transport arrangements may need to be planned for more severe MND patients who are bedridden, on tube feeding and portable ventilator support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Those facing financial difficulties may be referred to a medical social worker for help with their medical and transport costs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The National Neuroscience Institute (NNI) also provides follow-up video consultations for some less mobile MND patients to reduce their need to travel to clinic for consultation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Home-based nursing care has also been available for stable MND patients not on ventilation support through the NNI Community Health Programme since November 2020.

sections.label: MND home ventilation support
sections.summary: MND patients needing respiratory support can use the MOH-funded HVRSS, which provides home ventilation, caregiver training and follow-up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, MND patients needing respiratory support can tap on the the Ministry of Health (MOH)-funded national Home Ventilator and Respiratory Support Service (HVRSS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The HVRSS team from Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) provides home-based ventilation support, caregiver training and routine follow-up for chronic conditions, including blood tests, care coordination and referrals to other specialists, thus minimising clinic visits for the patient.
